posts.title: Mevdik's Website becomes MEVDIK.NET [blog,website]
posts.description: Migrating web hosts, getting a custom domain and the future of my websites. It is time. After 5 exciting months of hosting my main website on nekoweb.org I have now moved over to NearlyFreeSpeech.NET with a new domain and all. And so Mevdik's Website becomes MEVDIK.NET . I've been planning this move for a while now and I felt this was the right moment. I actually created my account on NFSN and bought my domain through there the 2nd of November (or 3rd if you go by UTC+00:00) but I wasn't ready to make the move until now, 20 something days later. "These thing take time" and all that. Why The reason why I decided to migrate hosts is twofold. First, I wanted to take my website and webmastery a bit more seriously, and I feel like using a paid web host that has been around since 2002 is a way to signal that, while hosting on neocities or nekoweb, especially with a a free account , feels a bit more "amateur", if that makes sense with no offence. posts.title: The years of the Linux desktop [blog,linux]
posts.description: Reviewing my first 2 years since leaving Windows 10 for Debian GNU/Linux, and what comes next. I've been a Microsoft Windows user all my life, if you are reading this on my website on its Mev9x era or if you've seen my old failed redesign you can probably tell just by looking. Ever since I was a kid making abstract art on MS Paint on my dad's Windows 95 machine, all the way until a year before Windows 10 went EOL , all I've known in the world of operating systems was Microsoft Windows. It was then, just a year away from the End of 10 , when I decided it was time to leave Windows behind and start using GNU/Linux instead, for I was not going to "upgrade" to Windows 11 once Windows 10 was taken off life support. Fuck that . Virtual Machines, son! Having had little to no prior experience with Linux based systems, other than installing Ubuntu on a school computer over a decade ago, I decided to test the waters in a safe environment first: Virtual Machines.
